notes.title: Darkflow proudly shines among the stars at the Space Exploration Fest!
notes.content:
In Darkflow, you'll navigate a hostile universe as a mercenary, making life-or-death decisions in real-time combat while experiencing a compelling narrative where every choice shapes your story. Uncover deep lore, adapt your tactics on the fly, and survive in the cold depths of space in this immersive blend of story, exploration, adventure, and survival. Join us as we take part in [b]Steam's Space Exploration Fest from September 2nd, 10:00 am PDT to September 9th, 10:00 am PDT.[/b]

[previewyoutube=YRhYWTWLbY4;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121496/91933f591d4d5fdc3d8a8b1baab6c097de1f7ab2.png[/img]

Get a first glimpse into life beyond the veil and see where you stand in a universe marred by a war of betrayal and at a time when being human alone is enough to make you a target. Featuring the most accurate representations of a black hole in any game or film, Darkflow brings an unprecedented space experience to you with stunning levels of fidelity as well as a deep, galaxy-spanning story influenced by your choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121496/84d3793f1c4eb18be8242dae290edc5a1bb20222.png[/img]

This is only the beginning! 

Darkflow’s development will be shaped significantly by our community’s feedback as we prepare for our early access launch in 2024. Be sure to wishlist and follow our Steam page for exciting updates and surprises along the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121496/85b3c8285c30f2812d57a26afad2dec94b90930e.png[/img]

[b][i]Darkflow's Black Hole[/i][/b]

Featuring one of the most accurate representations of a Black Hole in any game or film, Darkflow aims to bring an unprecedented space experience to your desktop PC with stunning levels of fidelity. Designed and created by Haider Ali, who ensures the accurate representation of space in our game, Darkflow features Black Holes based on real physics and matches current theories, accurately representing gravitational lensing, Kerr distortion, relativistic beaming, Doppler shift and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121496/719c98f2897442d11596c348dc77c8ff3ae3b1bb.png[/img]
